raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "absolute side length of the square",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The Fig. 2a setup paragraph specifies a square and its subdivision, but gives no dimensional side length L.",
      "readings": [
        "L = 1 m",
        "L = 0.1 m",
        "L = 1 in nondimensional coordinates"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "out-of-plane thickness or reference depth",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The two-coordinate model has no stated thickness or convention for reporting energy per unit depth. For a fixed two-dimensional constitutive model, uniform thickness changes only the dimensional response scale.",
      "readings": [
        "Use unit out-of-plane depth",
        "Use uniform thickness t = L/100",
        "Use uniform thickness t = L/50"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_location_extent",
      "entity": "roller at the bottom left",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "The Fig. 2a paragraph says 'bottom left edge' without coordinates or supported length. The vertical restraint itself is explicit. Taking the lower-left corner as (0,0), plausible placements differ.",
      "readings": [
        "Restrain vertical displacement only at the corner node (0,0)",
        "Restrain vertical displacement on the bottom segment y = 0, 0 <= x <= L/4",
        "Restrain vertical displacement on the left segment x = 0, 0 <= y <= L/4"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_position",
      "entity": "downward force near the top right",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "The Fig. 2a paragraph specifies 'at the top right edge' without identifying a corner, boundary segment, or coordinate. Coordinates below use the lower-left corner as (0,0).",
      "readings": [
        "Apply the force at the upper-right corner (L,L)",
        "Apply the force at the top-edge node (3L/4,L)",
        "Apply the force at the right-edge node (L,3L/4)"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "spatial distribution of the downward force",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "The Fig. 2a paragraph calls the loading a force applied at an edge, but does not distinguish a concentrated load from an edge traction or specify traction length and profile.",
      "readings": [
        "Concentrated nodal force at the selected boundary point",
        "Uniform downward traction over the rightmost quarter of the top boundary",
        "Uniform downward traction over the uppermost quarter of the right boundary",
        "Uniform downward traction over the rightmost half of the top boundary",
        "Downward traction over the rightmost top-boundary quarter, increasing linearly toward the upper-right corner"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "overall applied force scale",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No force magnitude or traction amplitude is stated. Holding its spatial distribution fixed, this scales dimensional compliance and cancels from the normalized objective in Eq. (4).",
      "readings": [
        "Total downward resultant P = 1 N",
        "Total downward resultant P = 1000 N"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "two-dimensional elastic constitutive model",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The compliance formulation and FEM Methods do not identify the square model as plane stress or plane strain.",
      "readings": [
        "Plane stress",
        "Plane strain"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Poisson ratio",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (6) specifies the Young's-modulus interpolation but gives no Poisson ratio for the elastic constitutive tensor.",
      "readings": [
        "Constant nu = 0.2",
        "Constant nu = 0.3",
        "Constant nu = 0.45"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "solid Young's modulus Y0",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (6) names Y0 without assigning a value. With epsilon/Y0 held fixed, changing this overall stiffness scale only rescales dimensional compliance and cancels from Eq. (4).",
      "readings": [
        "Y0 = 1 GPa, with epsilon scaled proportionally",
        "Y0 = 100 GPa, with the same epsilon/Y0"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "ersatz void stiffness epsilon",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Eq. (6) describes epsilon only as 'a small number'. Its ratio to Y0 determines the solid-to-void stiffness contrast.",
      "readings": [
        "epsilon/Y0 = 0.001",
        "epsilon/Y0 = 0.000001",
        "epsilon/Y0 = 0.000000001"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "mechanical displacement element and interpolation order",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The 4 by 4 rectangular design partition and bilinear nodal density interpolation are specified, but the displacement approximation used by FEM is not. Sharing an element partition does not determine the displacement order.",
      "readings": [
        "Four-node bilinear displacement elements on the stated 4 by 4 rectangular partition",
        "Nine-node biquadratic displacement elements on the same partition, retaining the stated 25 bilinear density variables"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "stiffness and elastic-energy quadrature",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The text describes quadrature for the volume constraint, but does not specify integration of the spatially varying SIMP stiffness or elastic energy.",
      "readings": [
        "Use 2 by 2 Gauss integration per rectangle, evaluating bilinear density and Eq. (6) at each point",
        "Use 3 by 3 Gauss integration per rectangle, evaluating bilinear density and Eq. (6) at each point"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "additional compliance optimization filtering",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No compliance-specific optimization filter is identified. Bilinear density interpolation is specified; the Helmholtz-filter passage in Methods concerns the heat example and does not establish a compliance filter.",
      "readings": [
        "No additional filter beyond the stated bilinear density interpolation",
        "Apply a nodal sensitivity filter with cone weights, radius 3L/8, and boundary renormalization",
        "Apply a nodal sensitivity filter with cone weights, radius L/2, and boundary renormalization"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "initial design for the MMA benchmark",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Methods identifies MMA, but gives no starting density field for that benchmark. The uniform field in Eq. (4) is explicitly an energy reference, not an identified optimizer initialization.",
      "readings": [
        "Initialize every nodal density to 0.5",
        "Initialize nodal densities from rho(x,y) = 0.25 + 0.5x/L, which also has volume fraction 0.5"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "remaining MMA step controls and iteration budget",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Methods supplies the MMA optimality tolerance of 0.001, but does not give move limits, asymptote controls, or an iteration cap needed to reproduce the optimization run.",
      "readings": [
        "Density move limit 0.2; initial asymptote half-width 0.5; shrink/expand factors 0.7/1.2; cap 1000 iterations; retain tolerance 0.001",
        "Density move limit 0.05; initial asymptote half-width 0.1; shrink/expand factors 0.5/1.05; cap 10000 iterations; retain tolerance 0.001"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "mechanical linear-solve accuracy",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Methods names COMSOL Multiphysics 5.4, but does not state the mechanical linear solver or residual tolerance. These choices leave finite-accuracy reproduction unspecified.",
      "readings": [
        "Direct factorization to numerical precision",
        "Preconditioned conjugate gradients with relative residual tolerance 0.000001",
        "Preconditioned conjugate gradients with relative residual tolerance 0.0000000001"
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    }
  ]
}
